title: Fourier Epicycles Transform
subtitle: Complex Phasor Harmonic Decomposition & Spectrum Analyzer
description: Visualizes the mathematical foundation of the Fourier Transform in the complex plane. Chains rotating complex exponential phasor gears (epicycles) summing harmonic modes to reconstruct complex geometric curves, complete with live amplitude spectrum bars.
mathNotation: f(t) = \sum_{k=-N}^{N} c_k e^{i k \omega t}, \quad c_k = \frac{1}{T} \int_0^T f(t) e^{-i k \omega t} dt
formulaCompact: z(t) = sum(c_k * exp(i * k * omega * t))

parameters.label: Harmonic Terms (N)
parameters.description: Number of active Fourier epicycle phasor modes
